content:
**Design-conformance scorecard vs brain's 7 product premises**

What: Added a design-conformance scorecard to the v2 audit (§0-bis of docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md), measuring code vs brain's 7 product premises. Average ~66%.
Scores: (1) harness-agnostic 60% PARTIAL — real port but phantom allow-list, default=antigravity betrays neutrality, day-start hardcodes gentle-ai; (2) SDD-agnostic WITH STAGE CONFIG 40% WEAKEST — SDD_ENGINE routes only init, stages HARDCODED in REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS const, not configurable; per-stage roles = #312 but 'configure the stages themselves' NOT on roadmap; (3) external reviewer + refuter 70% — real+provider-neutral, missing inline per-line comments + /1-vs-/2 schema drift; (4) memory-agnostic 90% STRONG — engram+plainfiles n=2, portable, integrity; (5) VCS-agnostic 75% — cleanest port but rung-2/rung-3 github-only; (6) project-flow visibility 55% — pieces exist but brain:status #280 NOT built; (7) evolutive memory in repo 85% STRONG — .memory/records git-native, session-start hydrates, ADR-0017; (8) minimize tokens 50% — context synthesizer #267 = targeted slice+core-floor+failsafe but NO measurement (Track G brain:metrics never built), no byte/token budget.
Context synthesizer (brain/scripts/context/synthesizer.mjs): emits core-floor (4 methodology files) + ADRs/memories matched to touched files by filename substring (naive), with CORE_FLOOR failsafe; emits references not full dumps. No explicit truncation cap.
NEW roadmap gap surfaced: 'configure SDD stages (add/remove/reorder phases)' is not ticketed anywhere — premise 2's hardest half. Pending user decision whether to add to epic #313.
Materialized: epic #313 + children #314 (dup 267 dir), #315 (hook dedup), #316 (.env unify), comment on #123 (personal remote). Hybrid cut chosen: M0->M1->M2->cut->M3-M7.
Related: [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]] [[architecture/v2-merge-audit]] [[architecture/sdd-role-neutrality]].
